title: Doggy Noses and Yoga Poses at Love City Brewing!
description: Join Us for Doggy Noses & Yoga Poses at Love City Manyunk to Benefit TLC Rescue.
long_description:
Join Us for Doggy Noses & Yoga Poses at Love City Manyunk to Benefit TLC Rescue.

About this Event

Join paws with us for a unique and heartwarming yoga class at Love City Brewing in Manyunk. Doggy Noses & Yoga Poses combines the joy of yoga with the cuddles of adorable rescue puppies and dogs from TLC Rescue
Event Highlights:
45-Minute Yoga Class: Certified yoga instructor Alyssia Saporito will lead a mixed-level yoga session while rescue puppies and dogs roam freely, providing cuddles and puppy kisses.15-Minutes of Snuggles: After yoga, enjoy a "snuggasana" session with the pups.Post-Yoga Pint: Relax in the tasting room with a pint from Love City Brewing (for guests 21 and over).Tickets:
Advance Purchase: $49.50At the Door: $60 (space permitting)A portion of all ticket proceeds will be donated to TLC Rescue.
Important Information:
Bring Your Own Mat: Please bring a yoga mat or towel.Limited Space: Space is limited, so order your Pawssport today!Respecting The Rescue: The only dogs allowed on the class floor will be the rescue and no food or treats will be allowed on the class floor.Spectators are NOT Allowed: To ensure the safety, privacy, and comfort of participants and event staff/volunteers.Event Participants: The recommended age is 12+ to attend the class, however, children who are able to behave appropriately in a yoga class are welcome with a legal guardian. We ask all event attendees to have a great time while remaining respectful of those around them.Join Us for a Fun and Furry Yoga Experience!

Also check out other in Philadelphia, Health & Wellness events in Philadelphia, Workshops in Philadelphia.
